tools.description: Launch the browser and optionally navigate to a URL. On macOS, installed browsers are searched in /Applications, then ~/Applications. Set the proxy in the server environment or config; percent-encoded proxy URL credentials are decoded before authentication. On Windows, owned headless Chrome uses a private desktop and its process tree closes with the daemon, including forced termination. Headed browsers use the interactive desktop.
